bug_description: mandatory_tools._extract_checks splits goal by newlines and processes each line independently. For inline compact numbered lists where all checks are on a single line, only the first matching pattern is extracted due to break after first match.
failing_format: inline compact numbered list: "1. Probe URL 2. Probe URL 3. Read repo status 4. In final answer..." all on one line
why_only_one_check: goal.splitlines() creates single element for single-line input
re.search finds first pattern match only
break statement exits after first match per line
No inline splitting by numbered markers (1., 2., 3., 4.)
No URL-safe split logic to preserve URLs while separating checks

tested_formats.A_multiline: Works: each check on separate line with newline
tested_formats.E_dash_bullet: Partial: may work if each on separate line, fails if inline
